verdict.rationale: FreshBooks publishes a documented public REST API. It uses OAuth 2.0 with per-endpoint scopes and covers clients, invoices, payments, expenses, bills, journal entries and reports. Error docs, request limits, a Postman collection and an official Node.js SDK round it out, so an agent can drive core accounting workflows programmatically. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of API use (all evidence is first-party), and machine-readable docs (llms.txt and markdown docs return 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: FreshBooks APIs use the OAuth 2.0 protocol for authentication and authorization

The API documentation index spans the full accounting surface: Clients, Credits, Invoices, Invoice Profiles, Other Income, Payments, Taxes, Online Payments, Expenses, Bill Vendors (beta), Bills, Expense Categories, plus Journal Entries and Reports
